# Colonial Barber Shop

> Old-school barbershop based in Bloomington, Indiana. Fades, classic cuts, color, braids and beard trims from Marny in a white-brick colonial house on E Winslow Rd. Blues and rock n roll on the radio, and she never rushes you out of the chair.

- Phone: (812) 272-6665
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.8 from 134 reviews
- Send a message: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/indiana/colonial-barber-shop/quote.html
- Hours and directions: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/indiana/colonial-barber-shop/book.html

## Services
- Fades & line ups: Skin fades, tapers, line ups and buzz cuts. One fellow barber called his "one of the best fades I ever got."
- Classic cuts & pompadours: Side parts, pompadours, scissor cuts and the classic barbershop cut, shaped to how your hair actually grows.
- Color & creative cuts: Bright color, undercuts, mohawks, braided tops and anything a little louder than the usual.
- Beard work & shaves: Reviewers come in specifically because Marny is good with beards. Trims, shaping, mustache work and fresh shaves.
- Kids' haircuts: Patient first cuts that go at your little one's pace, and a fun treat for the kids after.
- Seniors' cuts: Classic trims and scissor cuts for 65 and over, at a senior price.

## About
Colonial Barber Shop sits in a white-brick colonial house on E Winslow Rd, behind black shutters, an iron railing and a classic red, white and blue barber pole. When the OPEN sign is lit, the chair is ready. Marny cuts six days a week. Inside it's antique mirrors, brass-and-leather barber chairs, an old brass cash register under the Marny the Barber sign, an Indiana map and basketball poster on the walls, and the blues and rock n roll on the radio. No frills, just good cuts, for all kinds of hair: kids, teens, adults and seniors. As one regular put it, as busy as it gets, nobody gets rushed out of the chair.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can I walk in?
  A: Yes, stop by when the OPEN sign is lit: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 8:30 AM to 2 PM. If you want to be sure the chair is free, call (812) 272-6665 first.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 235 E Winslow Rd, Bloomington, IN 47401. It's the white brick colonial-style house with black shutters, an iron railing and a barber pole by the door.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes, including first haircuts. Parents say Marny goes at the child's pace, and you can ask for a lock of hair to take home.
- Q: Do you do beards and shaves?
  A: Yes. Beard trims, mustache work and shaves, on their own or with a haircut.
- Q: Can I get color or something creative?
  A: Yes. Color, undercuts, mohawks, braids and patterned parts all come out of this chair. Bring a photo if you have one.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: Kids 1 to 12 are $20, teens $25, adults $30 ($35 with beard work) and seniors 65 and over $25. Beard work on its own runs $25 to $30.
